purpose: Add a bounded read-only cross-format plug-in package discovery substrate over standard OS/format locations and caller-explicit additional roots without loading plug-ins or upgrading discovery into entitlement, hostability, control or semantic Tool identity.

lineage.outcome: The artist can have N0TE find plug-in packages in known format/OS locations without teaching every standard folder, while discovery remains visibly distinct from entitlement, hostability, control and semantic Tool identity.

why_now: Global reselection found canonical REQ-SCOPE-150 a required Gate-B blocker, unowned and implementation-missing while existing Tool/Studio contracts already defined downstream semantic boundaries. The discovery implementation was reconstructed over current stable main rather than carrying stale ancestry, then received fresh exact-head cross-platform proof before integration.
instead_of_what: Do not collide with occupied Workspace/consumer composition work, attempt full plug-in hosting in one increment, silently crawl disks, or infer licensing/hostability/control from filenames. Build only the truthful discovery substrate first.

implementation_contract.root_truth: Scan only canonical format/OS default roots, environment-defined LV2/LADSPA roots where those specifications define them, and caller-explicit additional roots. Never perform an arbitrary whole-disk crawl.
implementation_contract.package_truth: A recognized filesystem package is DISCOVERED evidence only. Its path, filename or bundle name is not semantic Tool identity, license/entitlement proof, hostability, compatibility, parameter/state control or successful loading.
implementation_contract.format_truth: Recognize VST3, AU, CLAP, LV2, LADSPA and AAX only on applicable platforms. AAX discovery grants no standalone hosting claim; AU remains Apple-specific; LV2 bundle path/name does not replace URI identity.
implementation_contract.traversal_truth: Traversal is bounded by explicit budgets, does not recurse into recognized package boundaries, and does not silently follow recursive directory symlinks.
implementation_contract.mutation: Discovery performs no plug-in load, audio processing, activation, purchase, license probe, DAW/provider action, custom-path persistence, semantic Tool persistence or external write.

completion_proof: deterministic injected macOS, Windows and Linux contexts produce the expected bounded standard roots for supported formats
VST3, AU, CLAP, LV2, LADSPA and AAX packages are recognized only on applicable platforms and are reported as discovery evidence only
LV2_PATH and LADSPA_PATH are parsed as explicit format search roots without inventing equivalent environment variables for other formats
caller-explicit additional roots can be scanned without being persisted by this increment
missing, unreadable and bounded-out root states remain distinct from an empty successfully scanned root
duplicate roots and package observations are deterministically de-duplicated
recognized package directories are not recursively descended and recursive directory symlinks are not silently followed
malformed semantic inputs fail closed rather than gaining meaning through implicit string/bool coercion
result objects expose no field that grants entitlement, hostability, control, execution or semantic Tool identity
full regression and staged consumer smoke passed at the exact integrated implementation head on Linux, Windows and macOS

evidence_snapshot.execution_note: Exact implementation head passed dependency installation, exact checkout, construction governance, context lifecycle governance, supervision, full regression, staged consumer smoke, evidence upload and exact-head success publication on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows before PR #171 merged as 4dc0d5dc9e2ea6b0584bd4fe179d32bd0c65f51c.

non_scope: custom plug-in path persistence or UI
semantic Tool identity normalization from discovered packages
VST3, AU, CLAP, LV2, LADSPA or AAX loading/processing
out-of-process crash isolation or architecture bridging
marking AUDIO-02 DONE or claiming full REQ-SCOPE-150 completion
shared_integration_points: Reads the existing semantic format vocabulary from n0te2.tools only; does not modify Tool/Studio semantics, entitlement truth, Song Reference evidence/closure, Relevance Broker, Direct Fan, evidence freshness, role economics, business opportunities, memory.py, package initialization, ConsumerShell, provider/DAW adapters or persistence schemas
next_selection_rule: This bounded plugin-discovery increment is closed. Keep AUDIO-02 PRESERVED and globally reselect from fresh main; do not automatically extend into hosting, entitlement, custom-path persistence or consumer integration by adjacency.
